lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par myi shes na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par shes la/ chos smra ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gtan la bab pa bstan pa'i chos kyi khyad par myi shes na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan la/ chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang myi ldan na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed

pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan la/ chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang myi ldan na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs mkhas la/ chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la/ thabs myi mkhas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs mkhas la/ chos smra ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la thabs myi mkhas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gzungs thob par gyur la/ chos nyan pa ni gzungs ma thob na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gzungs thob par gyur la/ chos

smra ba ni gzungs ma thob na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni bri bar 'dod/ klag par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton bya bar 'dod/ mnyan par 'dod/ bsgom par 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni bri bar myi 'dod/ klag par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton bya bar myi 'dod/ mnyan par myi 'dod/ bsgom par myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni bri bar 'dod/ klag par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton bya bar 'dod/ mnyan par 'dod la chos smra ba ni bri bar myi 'dod/ klag par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton bya bar myi 'dod/ bsgom par myi 'dod par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bral/ gnod sems dang snyom pa dang / gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang bral the tsom dang bral la/ chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bcas/ gnod sems dang snyom pa dang / gnyid dang / 'gyod pa dang bcas

the tsom dang bcas par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bral/ gnod sems dang / snyom pa dang / gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang bral/ the tsom dang bral la/ chos smra ba ni 'dod pa'i sred pa dang bcas/ gnod sems dang / snyom pa dang / gnyid dang / 'gyod pa dang bcas/ the tsom dang bcas par gyur na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe/ la la zhig der 'ongs te/ sems can dmyal ba'i myi snyan pa brjod/ byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas kyi yul gyi myi snyan pa brjod cing / sems can dmyal ba ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /byol song gi skye gnas ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /yi dgas kyi yul ni 'di ltar sdug bsngal lo/ /khyod kyis sdug bsngal 'di nyid du mthar phyin par gyis shig /gang la sdug bsngal stong phrag mang po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis khyod la ci zhig bya/ khyod yun ring por 'khor ba ni 'khor bar gyur ta re zhes zer na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / 'chad pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i tshe/ la la zhig der 'ongs te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod cing / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ mtshe ma'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshangs chen gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ snang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung snang gi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ dge ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung dge'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung che'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ myi che ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ myi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa

rjod/ gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'og myin gyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs par rjod/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi legs pa rjod cing / 'dod pa'i khams ni 'dod pa la longs spyod pas 'di ltar bde'o/ /gzugs kyi khams ni bsam gtan dang snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis 'di ltar bde'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i khams ni snyoms par 'jug pa zhi ba rnams kyis 'di ltar bde ste/ de dag kyang myi rtag cing sdug bsngal la bdag myed do/ /rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can zad pa'i chos can/ 'jig pa'i chos can/ skye ba'i chos can/ 'gag pa'i chos can yin gyis/ khyod kyis 'di nyid du rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyis shig /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyis shig/ 'di nyid du rang byang chub thob par gyis shig /phyin chad 'khor ba nam 'khor bar gyis shig ces zer na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la chos nyan pa ni 'khor gyi nang na gnas na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la/ chos smra ba ni 'khor gyi nang na gnas na/ /rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la/ chos nyan pa ni tshogs yongs su sdud na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gcig pu ste/ zla myed cing bdag gis byed pa yin la/ chos smra ba ni tshogs yongs su sdud na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni 'di skad du/ su nga'i phyi bzhin 'brang ba de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'drir sbyin no zhes zer la/ chos nyan pa ni phyi bzhin myi 'brang na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos

nyan pa ni chos smra ba'i phyi bzhin 'brang bar 'dod la chos smra ba ni drung du 'gro ba'i skabs myi 'byed na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'drir gzhug par 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug par 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir drung du 'gro bar ma mos na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bri bar 'dod/ klog par 'dod/ lung 'bog par 'dod/ kha ton bya bar 'dod/ sgom par 'dod/ nyan par 'dod la chos smra ba ni zang zing chung zad kyi phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sbyin par myi 'dod/ 'drir gzhug par myi 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug par myi 'dod/ sgom du gzhug par myi 'dod/ nyan du gzhug par myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang du srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs

der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gang du srog gi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'a dod la/ chos smra ba ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang na zas dkon pa dang / chu dkon pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa 'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos nyan pa ni gang na zas dkon pa dang / chu dkon pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos smra ba ni der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang chos smra ba ni gang na zas mod pa dang / chu mod pa'i phyogs der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa yang rjes su 'brang na/ des de la 'di skad du rigs kyi bu khyod zang zing gi don

tu song ste ji rung / legs par bsam pa sems par gyis shig /zas thob ma thob dang bsod myi bsod kyis 'gyod par gyur ta re zhes zer na/ de'i phyir chos ston pa des kyang / thabs phra mos chos la spang ba byas par 'gyur te/ de yang myi dga' zhing 'di snyam du 'du shes te/ 'di ni sbyin par 'dod pa'i mtshan ma ma yin gyi/ spong ba'i mtshan ma yin no snyam na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dge slong chos smra ba ni gang na rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom po'i 'jigs pa dang / rngon pa'i 'jigs pa dang / gcan zan khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / sprul gyi 'jigs pa dang / 'brog dgon pa'i 'jigs pa yod pa der 'gro bar 'dod la/ chos nyan pa dag kyang chos kyi don tu chos kyis skom zhing rjes su 'brang na/ dge slong chos smra bas chos nyan pa de dag la 'di skad smras te/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed gang na rkun po'i 'jigs pa dang / chom po'i 'jigs pa dang / rngon pa'i 'jigs pa dang / gcan zan khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang / sprul gyi 'jigs pa dang / 'brog dgon pa'i 'jigs pa yod pa der song ste/ ci rung zhes de ltar dge slong chos smra ba des chos myi bstan pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'drir gzhug par myi 'dod/ klog tu gzhug par myi 'dod/ lung 'bog par myi 'dod/ kha ton byed du gzhug par myi 'dod/ nyan du gzhug par myi 'dod par gyur la/ de dag gis dge slong chos smra ba'i tshig de dag thos nas/ myi dga' zhing myi dga' ba'i tshul can du gyur te/ dge slong

chos smra ba gang na ba der 'gro bar myi 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang dge slong chos smra ba ni bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong khyer gtso bor byed par 'gyur te/ de bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong khyer gtso bor gyur pas bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong de dag yang dang yang blta bar sems shing / der yang dang yang blta bas chos nyan pa phyir zlog cing / tshe dang ldan pa dag ngas ni bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong ba lta dgos te/ bsod snyoms gtong ba'i grong du 'gro dgos so zhes nas/ des chos nyan pa de dag phyir bzlog pa'i phyir 'dod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen mi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di su yang 'dri bar myi 'gyur ba dang / lung 'bog par myi 'gyur ba dang / kha ton byed par myi 'gyur ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed par myi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar thabs sbyor ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du bgyis shing / ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di su yang 'dri bar myi 'gyur ba dang / lung

'bog par myi 'gyur ba dang / kha ton bgyid par myi 'gyur ba dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid par myi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar thabs sbyor ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de la bdud sngig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / 'di skad du nged kyis ji ltar khong du chud pa 'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yin te/ ji skad du khyed klog pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin no zhes dbyen byed cing zlog la mos pa myed par byed do/ /rab 'byor de la bdud sdig to can gyis de ltar dbyen byas pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' gang lung ma bstan pa de dag ni the tsom skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag the tsom du gyur nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi 'dri bar 'gyur/ myi klog par 'gyur/ lung myi 'bog par 'gyur/ kha ton myi byed par 'gyur/ myi sgom par 'gyur/ tshul bzhin du yid la byed par myi 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa 'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs shing 'di skad du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la spyod pa de ni yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed par 'gyur te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /

de ni rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ro zhes zer na/ des tshig de thos nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la myi spyod na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ston pa'i tshe/ bar chad du 'gyur ba'i bdud kyi las mang du 'byung ste/ bdud kyi las de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bya'o/ /rig par byas nas rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdud kyi las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bgyi ste/ spang bar bgyi ba de dag gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las/ rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzugs brnyan ni bdud kyi las te/ de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos rig par bya ste/ rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nyan thos kyi theg pa dang ldan pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang ldan pa'i mdo sde dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen pos rig par bya ste rnam par spang bar bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgom tshan ma myed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa myed pa gang gis/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub thob par 'gyur ba de dag kyang bdud sdig to can dag dge slong gi cha byad du byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la nye bar bsnyen te/ de yang de la dga' ba bskyed na/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag

sangs rgyas kyi cha byad du lus gser gyi kha dog dang / myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang ldan par byas shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du 'ongs te/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mos pa bskyed do/ /des mos pa bskyed nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyam par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i mdun du sangs rgyas las stsogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun nye bar ston te/ des de la 'dod pa skyed cing / bdag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di lta bur shog shig /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'dis tshogs yongs su bsdus pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dis chos ji ltar ston pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang chos bstan par bya'o zhes de de la 'dod pa skyed pas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyams par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang bdud sdig to can dag byang chub sems dpa' brgya phrag du ma/ byang chub

sems dpa' stong phrag du ma/ byang chub sems dpa' brgya stong phrag du ma/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de lta bu dag nye bar ston te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa de dag la 'dod pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /des de dag la 'dod pa bskyed nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las yongs su nyams par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / sgom pa dang tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i rgyu rkyen myi ldan pa ste/ rab 'byor de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la gzugs myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig myed do/ /rna ba myed do/ /sna myed do/ /lce myed do/ /lus myed do/ /yid myed do/ /gzugs myed do/ /sgra myed do/ /dri med do/ /ro myed do/ /reg myed do/ /chos myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid

kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sa'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /ma rig pa myed do/ /'du byed myed do/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /reg pa myed do/ /tshor ba myed do/ /sred pa myed do/ /len pa myed do/ /srid pa myed do/ /skye ba myed do/ /rga shi myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid

stong pa nyid myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myed do/ /byams pa chen po myed do/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myed do/ /rang byang chub myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gang la gzugs myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la tshor ba myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la 'du

shes myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la 'du byed myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rnam par shes pa myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myig myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rna ba myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sna myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lce myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lus myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la

yid myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gzugs myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sgra myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la dri myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la ro myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la reg myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' med do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la chos myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myig gi rnam par shes pa myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /

myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la bsam gtan rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ciri phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la tshad myed pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rnam par thar pa brgyad myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la mngon par shes pa

rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la ting nge 'dzin rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la myi 'jigs pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la snying rje chen po myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la sangs rgyas

kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la dgra bcom pa nyid myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la rang byang chub myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gang la bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub myed pa de la sangs rgyas myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' myed do/ /rang sangs rgyas myed do/ /nyan thos myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor chos thams cad ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo // //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bdun pa/

rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang ba ste/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag la yang bar chad du 'gyur ba mang ngo / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i rin po che gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / baiḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang zhing phyir rgol ba mang ba dag go/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag la yang bdud kyi las mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bar chad mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyir rgol ba mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byar kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni de bzhin no/ /bde bar gshegs pa de ni de bzhin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i rin po che gser dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / baiḍūr+ya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / dngul dang / sa le sbram gang ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag ni bar chad du 'gyur ba mang zhing slar rgol ba mang ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag la yang bdud kyi las mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bar chad mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /slar rgol

ba mang po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa gang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag gi bar chad bgyid pa ni bdud kyi byin kyis brlabs pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa de dag ni blo chung zhing blo zhan par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu glen pa gang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag gi bar chad bgyid pa de dag ni blo rgyu shin tu chung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rlabs po che dag la de dag gi sems myi 'jug go/ /de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi 'dri myi klog/ lung myi 'bog /kha ton myi bgyid/ myi sgom/ tshul bzhin du yid la myi bgyid de/ gzhan 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bgyid pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa dag la yang bar chad bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi 'dri myi klog /lung myi 'bog/ kha ton myi byed/ myi sgom/ tshul bzhin du yid la myi byed cing / gzhan 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag gi bar chad byed pa de dag ni bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa/ theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa dge ba'i rtsa ba ma

bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu chung ba/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsgrubs pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma zin pa sha stag 'byung ste/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag ni blo chung zhing blo zhan par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di myi 'dri/ myi klog /lung myi 'bog /kha ton myi byed/ myi sgom/ tshul bzhin du yid la myi byed cing / gzhan 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag gi bar chad byed pa de dag ni blo rgya shin tu chung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rlabs po che dag la de dag gi sems myi 'jug go/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dag la bdud kyi las 'di dag kyang 'byung mod kyi 'on kyang / rab 'byor rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog cing kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / gong du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / bzod pa'i pha la rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gong du nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / stong pa

nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gong du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / dbang po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gong du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / bsam gtan rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa

dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / thams cad shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed na/ rab 'byor de ni sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin par shes par bya ste/ des rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri'o/ klog go/ /lung 'bog go /kha ton byed do/ /tshul bzhin du yid la byed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /phyi stong pa

nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /dbang po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gong du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /bsam gtan rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yongs su

rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /lho phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /nub phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan

'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa

dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ 'og gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bri ba dang / klag pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton bya ba dang / bstan pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ba'i phyir dgongs pa mdzad do/ /shar phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /lho phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri

zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /nub phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /byang phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa

gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /'og gi phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /steng gi phyogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir myi ldog pa gang ji snyed pa de dag kyang / rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dri zhing / klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / ston pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag gi don tu brtson par byed cing yongs su 'dzin par byed do/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ bud myed la la zhig la bu lnga 'am/ bcu'am/ nyi shu 'am/ sum cu 'am/ bzhi bcu 'am/ lnga bcu 'am/ brgya 'am/ stong zhig yod na/ de dag ni ma de ci nas kyang myi na bar bya ba'i phyir brtson par byed cing / bdag cag gi ma 'di ji ltar na nad myed par 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di

la ji ltar na bar chad du myi 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di ji ltar na ring du 'tsho bar 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ma 'di ring du 'tsho bar bya na ji ltar bya/ bdag cag gi ma 'di lus la myi bde ba'i nyams myed par bya na ji ltar bya/ 'di ni bdag cag skyed skyed pa ste/ srog gi sbyin bdag go zhes de dag ma de la rim gro legs par bya bas rim gro byed do/ /de dag ni 'di'i srog gi bar chad du gyur du 'ong ngo / /lus nyams chung bar gyur du 'ong ngo / /lus la sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrul gyis gtse ba'i myi bde bas bab tu 'ong ngo / /tsha ba dang / grang ba dang / bkres pa dang / skom pas myi bde bar 'gyur du 'ong ngo zhes phu dud legs par bya bas phu dud byed do/ /de ltar bu de dag ma de la 'di ni bdag cag skyed skyed pa'o/ /'di ni 'jig rten 'di ston pa'o zhes bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rgyun tu rim gro byed cing / sti stang dang / bkur sti cher byed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bdag cag gi sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skyed skyed pa'o/ /'jig rten 'di ston ston pa'o zhes rgyun tu gzigs shing dgongs so/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyispyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /lho phyogs

kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khasam gaṅgā'i klug gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gajigs shing dgongs so/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed da dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyispyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang / chos ston pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams skyed skyed pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes 'di yang ston ston pa'o/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni nang stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni phyi stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni chen po stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni myi dmyigs pa

stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni dbang po rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni stobs rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni bsam gtan rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni tshad myed pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni rnam par thar pa brgyad do/ /'di las byung ba ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'o/ /'di las byung ba ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa'o/ /'di las byung ba ni mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni myi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni snying rje chen po'o/ /'di las byung ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /'di las byung ba ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /'di las byung ba ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'o/ /'di las byung ba ni dgra bcom pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni rang byang chub bo/ /'di

las byung ba ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /'di las byung ba ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /'di las byung ba ni rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni phyir myi 'ong ba rnams mo/ /'di las byung ba ni dgra bcom pa rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di las brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'dri zhing klog pa dang / lung 'bog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / sgom pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par gzigs shing dgongs so/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ci nas kyang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las yongs su nyam par myi 'gyur bar rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad par bsrung ba mdzad do/ /rab

'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang 'di skad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams skyed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'jig rten ston pa'o zhes bka' stsal pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams skyed pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten ston pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas de bzhin gshegs pa bskrun pa lags/ 'jig rten ni de bzhin gshegs pas gang la gsungs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bskyed do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi bskyed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi bskyed do/ /byams pa chen po bskyed do/ /snying rje chen po bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad bskyed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid bskyed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bskyed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bskyed do/ /rab 'byor chos de dag gis ni de bzhin gshegs par brjod de/ rab 'byor de bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa bskyed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i 'jig rten gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten du gsungs so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mos phung po lnga

ni ji ltar bstan pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ji ltar phung po lnga ston pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni phung po lnga po 'di dag 'jig par ston pa ma yin/ rab tu 'jig par ston pa ma yin te/ skye zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /'gag ces bya bar myi ston to/ /kun nas nyon mongs shes bya bar myi ston to/ /rnam par byang zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /'phel zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /'grib ces bya bar myi ston to/ /blang zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /dor zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /'das shes bya bar myi ston to/ /ma 'ongs shes bya bar myi ston to/ /da ltar byung zhes bya bar myi ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ stong pa nyid la 'jig pa myed do/ /rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /mtshan ma myed pa la 'jig pa myed do/ /rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /smon pa myed pa la 'jig pa myed do/ /rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa la 'jig pa'am rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /skye ba myed pa la 'jig pa 'am rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa la 'jig pa 'am rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /rang bzhin myed pa la 'jig pa 'am rab tu 'jig pa myed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten ston par gsungs te/ rab 'byor sems can tshad myed grangs myed dpag tu myed pa'i sems dang spyod pa mkhyen pa de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid la brten cing rab tu mkhyen te/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la ni sems can myed do/ /sems can du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed do/ /gzugs su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed do/ /

tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myed do/ /'du shes su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed do/ /'du byed du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig myed do/ /myig tu gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba myed do/ /rna bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna myed do/ /snar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lce myed do/ /lcer gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus myed do/ /lus su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /yid med do/ /yid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed do/ /gzugs su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sgra myed do/ /sgrar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dri myed do/ /drir gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ ro myed do/ /ror gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /reg myed do/ /reg tu gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /chos myed do/ /chos su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa

myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams myed do/ /sa'i khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams myed do/ /chu'i khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /mye'i khams myed do/ /mye'i khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams myed do/ /rlung gi khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa myed do/ /ma rig par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myed do/ /'du byed du gdags

pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myed do/ /rnam par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs myed do/ /mying dang gzugs su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug myed do/ /skye mched drug tu gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa myed do/ /reg par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myed do/ /tshor bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa myed do/ /sred par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /len po myed do/ /len par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa myed do/ /srid par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba myed do/ /skye bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi myed do/ /rga shir gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa mi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid du

gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams myed do/ /yang dag par spong bar gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po rnams myed do/ /dbang por gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /stobs rnams myed do/ /stobs su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi

yan lag rnams myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan rnams myed do/ /bsam gtan du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa rnams myed do/ /tshad myed par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myed do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgur gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myed do/ /mngon par shes par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgor gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs su gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams myed do/ /myi 'jigs par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po myed do/ /snying rje

chen por gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres par gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /thams cad shes pa nyid myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gdags pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'jig rten ston pa yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di ni gzugs ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /'du shes ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /'du byed ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /myig ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rna ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sna ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lce ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lus ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /yid ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /gzugs ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sgra ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /dri ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /ro ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /reg ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /chos ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ston par

byed pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sa'i khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /chu'i khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /mye'i khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rlung gi khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /nam mkha'i khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /ma rig pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /'du byed ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rnam par shes pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /mying dang gzugs ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /skye mched drug ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /reg pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /tshor ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sred pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /len pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /srid pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /skye ba ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /rga shi ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed pa ma yin no/ /shes rab kyi pha rol
