pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ ma rig pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam 'du byed la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ 'du byed mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rnam par shes pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rnam par shes pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam mying dang gzugs la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa mi 'byung ba'i tshe/ mying dang gzugs mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam skye mched drug la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ skye mched drug mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam reg pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa mi 'byung ba'i tshe/ reg pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam tshor ba la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ tshor ba mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam sred pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ sred pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam len pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ len pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam srid pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ srid pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam skye ba la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ skye ba mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rga shi la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rga shi mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthong

ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam nang stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam phyi stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ phyi stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam phyi nang stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ phyi nang stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam chen po stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ chen po stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam don dam pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ don dam pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam 'dus byas stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /

nam 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rang bzhin stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam chos thams cad stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo

nyid stong pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dran pa nye bar gzhag pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam yang dag par spong ba la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ yang dag par spong ba rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dbang po la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dbang po rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam stobs la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ stobs rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam byang chub kyi yan lag la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa mi 'byung ba'i tshe/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyadapal dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam 'phags pa'i bden pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam bsam gtan la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ bsam gtan rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam tshad myed pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ tshad myed pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rnam par thar pa

brgyad la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rnam par thar pa brgyad mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam mngon par shes pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ mngon par shes pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam ting nge 'dzin la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam gzungs kyi sgo la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ gzungs kyisga rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam myi 'jigs pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ myi 'jigs pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam so so yang dag par rig pa la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam snying rje chen po la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ snying rje chen po mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la dmyigs pa'i+i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ sangs

rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam dgra bcom pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ dgra bcom pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rang byang chub la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rang byang chub mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /nam rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dmyigs pa'i rnam par shes pa myi 'byung ba'i tshe/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mthong ba myed pa'i phyir ston pa'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di de bzhin gshegs pa skyed cing 'jig rten ston pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa skyed cing 'jig rten ston pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'jig rten du stong pa zhes rjod de/ 'jig rten du ci stong pa zhes rjod ce na/ gzugs stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /tshor ba stong ngo zhes byu bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'du shes stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'du byed stong ngo zhes bya

bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myig stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rna ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sna stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lce stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lus stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /yid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /gzugs stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sgra stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dri stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rdzod do/ /ro stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /reg stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rdzod do/ /chos stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg

pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sa'i khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /chu'i khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /mye'i khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rlung gi khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /nam mkha'i khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /ma rig pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'du byed stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rnam par shes pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /mying dang gzugs stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /skye mched drug stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /reg pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /tshor ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du dzod do/ /sred pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /len pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /srid pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /skye ba stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rga shi stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong ngo zhes bya

bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /nang stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du brjod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dbang po rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /stobs rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams stong ngo

zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /bsam gtan rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rdzod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rdzod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /byams pa chen po stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /snying rje chen po stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rang byang chub stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid stong ngo zhes bya bar 'jig rten du rjod do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa skyed cing 'jig rten ston pa'o/ /rab 'byor

gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten stong ngo zhes bya bar ston/ 'jig rten stong zhes bya bar rjod/ 'jig rten stong zhes bya bar shes par byed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa skyed cing 'jig rten ston pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten stong zhes bya bar ston te/ 'jig rten stong zhes bya bar ji ltar ston ce na/ 'jig rten na gzugs stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'du shes stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'du byed stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myig stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rna ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sna stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lce stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lus stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na yid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na gzugs stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sgra stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dri stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na ro stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na reg stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na chos stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myig gi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rna ba'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sna'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lce'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lus kyi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na yid kyi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myig gi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya

bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sna'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lce'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lus kyi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na yid kyi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sa'i khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na chu'i khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na mye'i khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rlung gi khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten nam mkha'i khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam par shes pa'i khams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na ma rig pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'du byed stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na mying dang gzugs stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na skye mched drug stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na reg pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na tshor ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sred pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na len pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /

'jig rten na srid pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na skye ba stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rga shi stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten nang stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na phyi stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na phyi nang stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na chen po stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na don dam pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'dus byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rang bzhin stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na chos thams cad stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dngos

po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na yang dag par spong ba rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dbang po rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na stobs rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na byang chub kyi yan lag rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na bsam gtan rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na tshad myed pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam par thar pa brgyad stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na mngon par shes pa rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na ting nge 'dzin rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na gzungs kyi sgo rnams stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na myi 'jigs pa bzhi stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na byams pa chen po stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na snying rje chen po stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad

stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rang byang chub stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /'jig rten na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid stong zhes bya bar ston to/ /rab 'byor de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa skyed cing 'jig rten ston pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu pa/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston te/ ji ltar 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston ce na/ gzugs kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /'du shes kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /'du byed kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /myig gi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rna ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sna'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lce'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lus kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /yid kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /gzugs kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sgra'i 'jig rten bsam

gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /dri'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /ro'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /reg gi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /chos kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen

kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sa'i khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /chu'i khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /mye'i khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rlung gi khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /ma rig pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /'du byed kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /mying dang gzugs kyi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /skye mched drug gi 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /reg pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /tshor ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sred pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /len pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /srid pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /skye ba'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /rga shi'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'jig rten bsam gyis myi khyab ces bya bar ston to/ /brtson 'grus kyi

pa'o// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gcig pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di 'jig rten ci ltar ston ce na/ ji nas kyang 'jig rten 'di'i 'du shes su yang myi 'gyur la/ 'jig rten pha rol gyi 'du shes su yang myi 'gyur ba de ltar ston te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gang gis 'jig rten 'di'i 'du shes su 'gyur ba 'am/ 'jig rten pha rol gyi 'du shes su 'gyur ba'i chos de lta bu myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don chen po'i slad du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i slad du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don dpag tu ma mchis pa'i slad du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don gzhal du ma mchis pa'i slad du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i slad du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don chen po'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don dpag tu myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don gzhal du myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni

don myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don chen po'i phyir nye bar gnas pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don chen po ste/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad bskyab pa'i don dang / sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtang ba'i don to/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don chen po'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir nye bar gnas pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni bsam gyis myi khyab ste/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byar ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don dpag tu myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor sems can du bsdu bas bsdus pa la gang gis sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag par nus pa de lta bu gang yang myed de/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dpag tu myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

don gzhal du myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni gzhal du myed de/ sus kyang gzhal bar myi nus so/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don gzhal du myed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phyir nye bar gnas pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mnyam pas mnyam pa'ang su 'ang myed na/ lhag pa lta ci smos te/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi don myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni bsam gyis myi khyab bo/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang / rang byung nyid dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzugs kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag

tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du shes kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du byed kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rna ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sna yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lce yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lus kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor yid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzugs kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sgra yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor dri yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor ro yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /

rab 'byor reg kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor chos kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sna'i rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lce'i rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang bsam

gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sa'i khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor chu'i khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor mye'i khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rlung gi khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang

mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor nam mkha'i khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor ma rig pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du byed kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor mying dang gzugs kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor skye mched drug kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor reg pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshor ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sred pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor len pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor srid shes rab kyi pha rol tu kyi na pa stong zag brgya pa/ pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor skye ba yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rga shi yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang

mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor nang stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor phyi stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor chen po stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'dus

byas stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /

rab 'byor dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor dbang po rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor stobs rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor bsam gtan rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshad myed pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa brgyad kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal

du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor mngon par shes pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor myi 'jigs pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor byams pa chen po yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor snying rje chen po yang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /rab 'byor sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed pa ste/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'o/ /

myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sgra bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dri bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ro bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du reg bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myig gi rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing /myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sna'i rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid kyi rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myig gi 'dus

te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sna'i 'dus te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i 'dus te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs

pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sa'i khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chu'i khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mye'i khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rlung gi khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du nam mkha'i khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa'i khams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ma rig pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'du byed bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis

gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mying dang gzugs bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye mched drug bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du reg pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshor ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis shes rab kyi pha rol tu gyin pa stong phrag brkya pa/ gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sred pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du len pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du srid pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye ba bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rga shi bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag

tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du nang stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam po dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi nang stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chen po stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du don dam pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa

dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'dus byas stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos thams cad stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs

pa lags/ ci'i slad du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yang dag par spong ba rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dbang po rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stobs rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan rnams

bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshad myed pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa brgyad bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mngon par shes pa rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ting nge 'dzin rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa

bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu ma mchis gzhal du ma mchis shing / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor tshor ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du shes la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'du byed la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor myig la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyamanyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor rna ba la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor sna la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lce la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor lus la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor yid la yang bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /

mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chu'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mye'i khams la/ bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rlung gi khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du nam mkha'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa'i khams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ma rig pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'du byed la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par shes pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mying dang gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye mched drug la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam

pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du reg pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshor ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sred pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du len pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du srid pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du skye ba la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rga shi la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam

pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyi nang stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chen po stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du don dam pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'dus byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang bzhin stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du chos thams cad stong pa nyid la bsam pa

dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du yang dag par spong ba rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dbang po rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du stobs rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du 'phags pa'i bden pa

rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du bsam gtan rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ciri slad du tshad myed pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du mngon par shes pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du ting nge 'dzin rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du gzungs kyi sgo rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du myi 'jigs pa rnams la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la bsam pa

dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du byams pa chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du snying rje chen po la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du dgra bcom pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rang byang chub la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ ci'i slad du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang / tshad dang mnyam pa dang myi mnyam pa myi dmyigs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ bsam gyis myi khyab dpag tu myed gzhal du myed la/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ste/ de'i phyir gzugs la bsam pa dang dpag pa dang /
